## Processing pipelines by data source

Pipelines are organised by data source and level of processing. Each pipeline folder in the repository should contain a README.md describing inputs, steps, outputs and links to scripts or notebooks.

::: {.card-grid}

::: {.vbl-card}
::: {.pill-mini}
UAV/airborne
:::

### UAV & airborne processing

Radiometric and geometric correction of UAV and airborne hyperspectral/thermal data, mosaicking, BRDF normalisation and co-registration with field plots. Output products include surface reflectance cubes, temperature maps and quality masks.
:::

::: {.vbl-card}
::: {.pill-mini}
Satellite EO processing
:::

### Satellite EO processing

Sentinel-2, PRISMA and EnMAP workflows (e.g. Sen2Cor atmospheric correction, spectral resampling, tiling and time-series aggregation), harmonised across sites for crop-stressor analysis and EO upscaling.
:::

::: {.vbl-card}
::: {.pill-mini}
RTM library & hybrid ML
:::

### Hybrid ML methods

PROSAIL / SCOPE forward simulations via ToolsRTM and SCOPEinR, LUT generation, plant trait retrieval, and hybrid ML models trained on combined RTM–EO features for stress detection
:::

:::

## Connected open-source ecosystem

HYDRA-EO is linked directly to
[RTM-Suite](https://ccgcam.github.io/RTM-Suite/), where the maintained
packages, reference manuals, tutorials and interactive applications are
published.

::: {.card-grid}
::: {.vbl-card .tool-card-r}
![](https://img.shields.io/badge/R-276DC3.svg?logo=r&logoColor=white){alt="R"}

### ToolsRTM & SCOPEinR

Generate reflectance, fluorescence, photosynthesis, temperature and
energy-balance simulations; build LUTs and train trait-retrieval models.

[R tools and manuals →](tools.qmd#r-packages)
:::

::: {.vbl-card .tool-card-python}
![](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-3776AB.svg?logo=python&logoColor=white){alt="Python"}

### toolsrtm & scopeinpython

Run the corresponding modelling and inversion workflows from Python, with
cross-language examples and numerical comparison.

[Python tools and manuals →](tools.qmd#python-libraries)
:::

::: {.vbl-card .tool-card-app}
![](https://img.shields.io/badge/R_Shiny-Interactive-1F77B4.svg?logo=rstudio&logoColor=white){alt="R Shiny"}

### Interactive applications

Explore PROSAIL, SCOPE, LUTs, inversion and STAC workflows through the
ToolsRTM.app interfaces.

[Open the applications →](https://ccgcam.github.io/RTM-Suite/#apps){target="_blank"}
:::
:::
